title: 飞船飞行与对接控制困难
description: 飞船飞行、驾驶和对接操作困难，包括控制过于灵敏、缺少方向控制、强制对接导致失控等，影响飞船操控体验。
evidence: the RCS use and control in docking is stupid finicky you can go towards the arrow only to super speed past the docking port then go back the same amount and never see it until its to late and you hit the ship
Flying your ship is so hard and not rewarding
the flying controls are extremely frustrating. I've watched tutorials and tried several different approaches but just keep crashing.

evidence_items.quote: was it really necessary to make flying spaceships this clunky and difficult and overly bloated?
evidence_items.description: 飞船操控笨重、困难且过于臃肿，令人烦躁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 真的有必要把驾驶飞船做得这么笨重、困难又过度臃肿吗？

evidence_items.quote: I even experienced some navigation issues (spaceship going to 500 V/rel)
evidence_items.description: 导航问题，飞船速度达到500 V/rel
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我甚至遇到了一些导航问题（飞船速度达到500 V/rel）

evidence_items.quote: the piloting controls are cancer
evidence_items.description: 驾驶操控体验极差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 驾驶操控简直是毒瘤

evidence_items.quote: Piloting the ship feels bad
evidence_items.description: 驾驶飞船手感差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 驾驶飞船的感觉很差

evidence_items.quote: the flying controls are extremely frustrating. I've watched tutorials and tried several different approaches but just keep crashing.
evidence_items.description: 飞船飞行控制极其令人沮丧，玩家反复坠毁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行操控极其令人沮丧。我看过教程，也试过好几种不同的方法，但就是一直坠毁。

evidence_items.quote: I když to létání, OMG
evidence_items.description: 飞行操作体验很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 虽然那个飞行，天哪

evidence_items.quote: ce système de navigation limite à l'aveugle
evidence_items.description: 导航系统几乎盲目，难以操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这个近乎盲目的导航系统

evidence_items.quote: god awful flight controls of the ship
evidence_items.description: 飞船飞行控制糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船那糟糕透顶的飞行控制

evidence_items.quote: if your docking and less than 10 seconds away from hard dock a patrol ship can literally force a hard dock then spin your ship 37000 km away into empty space
evidence_items.description: 巡逻船在接近硬对接时强制对接并将飞船旋转到远处
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你正在对接，而且距离硬对接不到10秒，一艘巡逻船可以字面意义上强行硬对接，然后把你的飞船旋转37000公里甩进空旷太空

evidence_items.quote: its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else
evidence_items.description: 自动驾驶无法将玩家带到目的地
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管尝试了几十次，我还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近

evidence_items.quote: sticking flight controls
evidence_items.description: 飞行控制出现粘滞/卡住的问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 卡住的飞行控制

evidence_items.quote: 和船体接轨过程更是让开船的难受程度更上一层楼
evidence_items.description: 船体接轨过程让开船体验更加难受
evidence_items.quote_zh: 和船体接轨过程更是让开船的难受程度更上一层楼

evidence_items.quote: 操船はなぜかほとんど手動であり、宇宙船の進路決定やドッキングするための位置合わせを上下左右・回転キーで細やかに操作する必要がある。
evidence_items.description: 手动操船需要上下左右和旋转键进行精细操作，繁琐且耗时。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 操船不知为何几乎全是手动操作，必须用上下左右和旋转键精细地操控，来决定宇宙船的航向以及对接时的位置对准。

evidence_items.quote: Flying your ship is so hard and not rewarding
evidence_items.description: 手动驾驶和对接操作困难且无成就感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 驾驶你的飞船太难了，而且毫无回报

evidence_items.quote: the flight controls are so bad
evidence_items.description: 飞行控制过于灵敏，键盘无法微调，导致难以到达首个任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行控制太糟糕了

evidence_items.quote: impossible controls that have somehow gotten worse, that allow me no control over my ship
evidence_items.description: 控制方式不可能，无法控制飞船。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不可能完成的操作，不知怎么还变得更糟了，让我完全无法控制我的飞船

evidence_items.quote: only thing ive managed is to crash and die time and time and time again
evidence_items.description: 操作飞船时反复坠毁死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我唯一做到的就是一次又一次又一次地坠毁和死亡

evidence_items.quote: this has to be the most stupid "flying" system ive seen its manual only
evidence_items.description: 飞行系统只能手动操作，难以掌握
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这一定是我见过的最愚蠢的“飞行”系统，它只能手动操作

evidence_items.quote: it would be easier to navigate if I could set an exact bearing for my craft
evidence_items.description: 无法设定精确方位，导航不便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果我能为我的飞船设定一个精确的方位，导航会更容易

evidence_items.quote: hope they add up and down direction in docking as well
evidence_items.description: 对接缺少上下方向控制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 希望他们在对接时也加入上下方向

evidence_items.quote: the RCS use and control in docking is stupid finicky you can go towards the arrow only to super speed past the docking port then go back the same amount and never see it until its to late and you hit the ship
evidence_items.description: 对接时RCS控制过于敏感，难以精确操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对接时RCS的使用和控制极其挑剔，你可以朝着箭头前进，却以超高速冲过对接端口，然后以同样的量返回，直到为时已晚撞上飞船才看到它。

evidence_items.quote: the flying mechanic makes me want to scream and i still just end up crashing into things and am forced to restart
evidence_items.description: 飞行操作困难导致撞毁并被迫重开
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行机制让我想尖叫，我还是会撞上东西，然后被迫重新开始
